title: Native humanoid pixel finish and narrower side modules
summary: Generator copy adds Clean armor ramps and calmer thin polygon corner pixels, plus front/back Sleek side-head modules reduced from 3 to 2 design pixels wide with helmet attachment retained. Profile discs retain geometry. New projects default Clean/Narrow; old configs without fields retain Legacy/Wide and Classic ignores flags. No global deletion filter; alpha silhouette and pose geometry preserved. Local 27 checks pass; browser verification pending. Owner visual approval pending.
